headline: Wedbush Assumes Oklo Coverage with Outperform Rating on Nuclear Progress
summary: Wedbush initiated coverage on Oklo stock with an outperform rating, citing progress in nuclear energy development.
why: Analyst initiations and ratings from major investment firms can influence institutional investor interest and short-term share price momentum.

impacts.name: Oklo
impacts.why: An outperform rating from a prominent analyst firm signals potential equity outperformance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An initial positive broker rating and commentary on nuclear progress encouraged buying interest in the stock.
